core.name: Might
core.text: +5 direct damage dealt per stack.

core.name: Weakness
core.text: −5 direct damage dealt per stack.

core.name: Vulnerable
core.text: +5 direct damage taken per stack.

core.name: Armor
core.text: −5 Normal damage taken per stack.

core.name: Shield
core.text: Absorbs Normal and Piercing damage until depleted.

core.name: Stunned
core.text: Cannot use skills.

core.name: Stunned (non-Strategic)
core.text: Cannot use non-Strategic skills (skills that deal direct damage).

core.name: Stunned (Strategic)
core.text: Cannot use Strategic skills.

core.name: Sleep
core.text: Stunned. Ends when the bearer takes damage.

core.name: Invulnerable
core.text: Cannot be targeted by enemy skills, and takes no damage from enemy triggered or ticking effects unless that damage is Affliction or Bypassing.

core.name: Ghosted
core.text: The bearer's skills Bypass (ignore Invulnerable and Isolated).

core.name: Untargetable
core.text: Cannot be targeted by enemy skills, but still takes triggered and ticking damage.

core.name: Isolated
core.text: Cannot be targeted by allied skills.

core.name: Shattered
core.text: Gets no benefit from Armor or Shield.

core.name: Swiftness
core.text: Ignores the next Stun effect applied (consumes one stack).

core.name: Intimidated
core.text: Cooldowns increased by 1 per stack.

core.name: Focus
core.text: Reduces skill costs by 1 GEN per stack.

core.name: Confusion
core.text: Increases skill costs by 1 GEN per stack. All of it ends once the bearer uses a skill.

core.name: Mark
core.text: When the bearer takes direct damage, they take 10 more damage and the Mark is consumed.

core.name: Taunted
core.text: Can only target the source of the Taunt.

core.name: Immune
core.text: Cannot have Debuffs applied.

core.name: Trap
core.text: A hidden effect on an enemy that fires when they use a skill (usually a Harmful one). Trap N: they take N damage the next time they use a Harmful skill.

core.name: Sanctify
core.text: When the bearer takes direct damage, the damager heals 15 HP.

core.name: Renew
core.text: At the end of the applier's turn, heals 5 HP per stack, then loses 1 stack.

statuses.name: Ignite
statuses.text: Takes 5 Affliction damage at the end of the applier's turn. Does not stack. If the applier is Flameborn, they heal for the damage dealt.

statuses.name: Scorched
statuses.text: Healing received is halved (rounded up to the nearest 5).

statuses.name: Flameborn
statuses.text: Heals for the damage dealt by the bearer's Ignites, and heals 10 whenever the bearer's side causes an Explosion.

terms.name: Explode
terms.text: 10 Affliction damage to every enemy of whoever caused it. Skips Invulnerable targets.

statuses.name: Frostbitten
statuses.text: Unable to use Harmful Strategic skills.

statuses.name: Chilled
statuses.text: Unable to have skill costs reduced.

statuses.name: Numb
statuses.text: Cannot apply Buffs (to anyone, including themselves).

statuses.name: Frostborn
statuses.text: Immune to Debuffs from Numb or Chilled units, and Invulnerable to Frostbitten units (they can't target or damage the bearer).

statuses.name: Flow
statuses.text: The bearer's skills ignore counters and reflects.

statuses.name: Charged
statuses.text: Charge (max 3). At 3, the owner generates 1 extra energy next turn and the Charge is spent.

statuses.name: Sapped
statuses.text: Max 3. At 3, the owner generates 1 less energy next turn and Sapped is removed.

statuses.name: Stormborn
statuses.text: Gains 1 Charge whenever it deals or receives damage (Charge caps at 3).

statuses.name: Conduit
statuses.text: Steals all Charge from enemies it damages. Allies with Charge that use Helpful skills on it transfer their Charge to it.

statuses.name: Rushing
statuses.text: On gaining it and at the start of each of the bearer's turns: 1 Swiftness and 1 Focus (until the next skill) if they have none. Ends at the end of a turn in which the bearer used no skill.

statuses.name: Leaping
statuses.text: +5 direct damage. Ends once a skill of the bearer's has dealt direct damage and resolved, or at the end of the bearer's next turn: one chance to act with it. (Leaping also grants Invulnerable for 1 turn, applied separately.)

terms.name: Immobile
terms.text: A character with no mobility skills (Charge, Maneuver, Mislead, Dance) and no mobility buffs (Swiftness, Rushing, Leaping).

statuses.name: Toxin
statuses.text: Takes 5 Affliction damage per stack at the end of the applier's turn. Stacks.

statuses.name: Prey (marked)
statuses.text: This unit is considered Prey.

terms.name: Prey
terms.text: A unit with more than 2 total stacks of Toxin, Weakness, Vulnerable and Confusion, or below 20 Health, or marked as Prey.

terms.name: Boulder
terms.text: A 45 Health minion with no skills, used as ammunition and as armor by Earth skills.

terms.name: Seedling
terms.text: A 15 Health minion whose Channel Earth gives its creator 1 Might and 1 Armor for good. Forest Stalkers count as Seedlings.

terms.name: Channel Growth
terms.text: Every allied Seedling gets +10 max Health, then heals 10.

statuses.name: Anointed
statuses.text: A mark that empowers Holy skills.

statuses.name: Condemned
statuses.text: The next time the bearer uses a skill, they randomly receive 1 Weakness, 1 Vulnerable or 1 Confusion, and Condemn is removed.

statuses.name: Horrified
statuses.text: Can't gain Buffs.

statuses.name: Immortal
statuses.text: Health can't fall below 5.

statuses.name: Soul Fragment
statuses.text: +5 direct damage dealt per stack (1 Might each). Permanent until consumed.

statuses.name: Lifesteal
statuses.text: Heals for the Health it removes from other characters.

statuses.name: Stealth
statuses.text: Untargetable by enemies. Skills give it for 2 turns. Ends after the bearer uses a skill that isn't Stealthy; a Stealthy skill extends it by 1 turn instead.

statuses.name: Blinded
statuses.text: The primary target of the bearer's single-target skills is chosen at random.

rules.name: Normal damage
rules.text: The default damage type. Reduced by Armor, absorbed by Shield.

rules.name: Piercing
rules.text: Damage type that ignores Armor but is absorbed by Shield.

rules.name: Affliction
rules.text: Damage type that ignores Armor and Shield, and gets through Invulnerable when indirect.

rules.name: Direct damage
rules.text: Damage dealt by a skill's use (including delayed hits like Snipe). Gets Might, Weakness and Vulnerable, and triggers "on direct damage" effects.

rules.name: Indirect damage
rules.text: Damage from triggered or ticking effects.

rules.name: Ticking effect
rules.text: An effect with an end-of-turn payload (damage or healing over time, Renew, a channel, a minion's attack). It fires at the end of its applier's turn, in the order that player chooses.

rules.name: Counter
rules.text: Negates a skill as it's used. Its cost stays paid, and its cooldown starts.

rules.name: Reflect
rules.text: A counter that also applies the skill to its user (or the user's team, for skills that hit a whole team).

rules.name: Harmful / Helpful
rules.text: Every skill is exactly one. Counters, Traps and Frostbitten key off Harmful.

rules.name: Strategic
rules.text: Skills that aren't explicitly directly damaging. Some stuns stop only Strategic or only non-Strategic skills.

rules.name: Channeled
rules.text: An ongoing skill effect on its user. It ends if the user is stunned, dies, or uses another skill.

rules.name: Invisible
rules.text: Hidden from the opponent until it triggers or expires.

rules.name: HiddenTarget
rules.text: The opponent sees the skill but not its target.

rules.name: Cooldown
rules.text: How many of its owner's own turns a skill stays locked after use.

rules.name: Random energy
rules.text: A wildcard cost (GEN, shown as a dashed square) that you pay with any color when you end your turn.

rules.name: Buff / Debuff
rules.text: Effect kinds: Buffs help their bearer, Debuffs hinder them. Immune blocks Debuffs.

rules.name: Minion
rules.text: A summoned unit. It has Health and maybe skills, generates no energy, and pays for its skills from its owner's energy.
